sections.title: 1. Mutual Fund Risk Disclosure
sections.copy: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully. The Net Asset Value (NAV) of schemes can go up or down based on market forces and interest rate changes. Past performance does not guarantee future results, and dividends or payouts depend on distributable surplus availability. Investors must read the Key Information Memorandum (KIM), Scheme Information Document (SID), and Statement of Additional Information (SAI) before investing.

sections.title: 2. Registrations & Capacities
sections.copy: Wording and holder details verified against official regulatory registrations.

sections.title: 3. Securities Market Risk
sections.copy: Investments in securities market are subject to market risks. Read all related documents carefully before investing. Lotus Capital acts as an Authorised Person of Religare Broking Limited (NSE AP007909931, BSE AP0130040172963).

sections.title: 4. Insurance Solicitation Notice
sections.copy: Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Policy terms, conditions, waiting periods, deductibles, and exclusions are determined by the respective underwriter.

sections.title: 5. Corporate Fixed Deposits & Bonds Risk
sections.copy: Fixed deposits with corporate issuers carry credit and issuer default risk. Market-linked debentures and corporate bonds are subject to liquidity and issuer risk.
